blocks.html: SHOP AT ROBINSONS MALLS AND GET THE CHANCE TO TAKE HOME A BRAND NEW LAPTOP

What better way to spend your shopping day knowing that you can get something more than what you purchased. Robinsons Malls does not only give you a complete shopping experience, but also the opportunity to join the 100 LAPTOP GIVEAWAY PROMO for a chance to win (1) of 100 laptop giveaways, together with ACER as its major sponsor.

Just present your P1,000.00 single receipt/s purchase, cash or charge, from any participating Robinsons Malls retail outlet, dated May 11 to June 28, 2015 to the promo clerk at any of the designated promo booths and have it stamped, to merit yourself one (1) raffle coupon. Fill out the raffle coupon with your complete name and signature, and drop at the designated boxes at the promo booths, which are open from Mondays through Sundays (mall and store opening to closing hours). The schedules of mall hours during holidays are posted at the mall and store entrance. The deadline for dropping of entries is on June 28, 2015 at the end of mall hours.
For more information, you may log in at www.robinsonsmalls.com or check the Robinsons Malls Facebook page at www.facebook.com/RobinsonsMalls.
